text: Taking the egg with `take egg` gained 5 points.
Opening the window and entering it with `open window`, then `enter window`, gained 10 points on entry to the Kitchen.
Moving the rug, opening the trap door, and going down with `move rug`, `open trap door`, and `down` gained 25 points on entry to the Cellar.
Taking the painting with `take painting` in Gallery gained 4 points; in this run it succeeded while carrying the egg, sack, and bottle.

Light the lantern before going upstairs or entering the dark cellar: `light lamp` and `light lantern` failed in the Kitchen because the lantern was there, but `light lantern` in the Living Room followed by `down` safely reached the Cellar; going down while dark produced a pitch-black grue warning.

Object weight can prevent some actions, but in this run `take painting` in Gallery succeeded while carrying the egg, sack, and bottle. In Studio, `climb chimney` failed even after reducing the load to only a leaflet, and was not retried after dropping the leaflet.

The first thief setback came after valuables were left in the Studio: after dropping the egg and bottle, the thief appeared, and `attack thief with sword` only hit his wrist; he escaped with the large bag and robbed you.

The death was caused by dropping the sword earlier, carrying the axe instead, and failing to defeat the thief: after `attack thief with axe` twice, the second attack missed and the thief stabbed you, reducing the score from 44 to 34.
Moving the leaves revealed a grating, but `open grating` showed that it was locked; it was never opened.
The wooden door with gothic lettering looked promising, but `open door` reported that it would not budge and it was never opened.
The trophy case looked potentially useful, but `examine trophy case` showed it was empty.
The dark chimney leading down and east looked promising, but it was never entered.
Trying `take paper` failed because the load was too heavy; carrying the egg, bottle, lantern, sword, painting, and sack caused this setback, and `drop sack` made the paper takeable.
Killing the troll with three `attack troll with sword` commands gained 5 points, reflected when going east into the East-West Passage.
Taking the platinum bar with `take platinum bar` gained 10 points after dropping the sack and painting to reduce the load.

The platinum-bar and painting setbacks were caused by carrying too much: `take platinum bar` failed while carrying the sack and painting, dropping the sack was insufficient, and dropping the painting made the bar takeable; later dropping the bottle made the painting takeable.

The death was caused by entering the thief encounter while carrying valuables including the egg and bottle, then making only one `attack thief with sword`; the sword missed and the thief killed you, reducing the score from 45 to 35.
The forbidding hole leading west looked promising but was never entered.
The grue death was caused by dropping the lantern with `drop lantern`, then entering Gallery's dark west passage with `west` and continuing north without a light; the grue killed you.

In Studio, `climb chimney` failed while carrying the leaflet, lantern, painting, bottle, sword, and egg; after dropping the bottle, painting, sword, and finally egg, it succeeded and returned to the Kitchen while the lantern and leaflet were still carried.
After `drop painting` in Studio, `take painting` in Gallery failed because the painting was no longer there; returning to Studio to retrieve it was never done.

Going `up` before obtaining and lighting the lantern caused a pitch-black grue warning; the lantern was in the Living Room, so this setback came from skipping `west`, `light lantern`, and then returning upstairs.

`take wrench` and repeated `take tube` failures were caused by carrying too much; dropping the sack allowed the wrench, and dropping leaflet, guidebook, matchbook, and bottle eventually allowed the tube.

In Maintenance Room, pushing the blue button caused a leak and raised the water to ankle height; pushing the yellow button raised it further to shin height while time was spent trying to manage the inventory.
The platinum bar was never successfully taken in this run: repeated `take platinum bar` and `take bar` commands only produced `bar bar ...` and no score increase.

The death was caused by entering the thief encounter while still carrying valuables including the egg and bottle, then making only one `attack thief with sword`; the sword missed and the thief killed you.
In Dam, the closed sluice gates were never opened; the scramble down was entered to Dam Base, where raft inflation was never completed.
The crack looked promising, but `enter crack` failed because you could not fit through it; it was never entered.

The death was caused by dropping the sword in Studio and entering the Troll Room without it; `attack troll with sword` failed because it was no longer carried, and `attack troll with knife` missed, letting the troll kill you and reduce the score from 44 to 34.
After `attack troll with sword` killed the troll, the sword disappeared; later attempts to take or use it reported that you did not have it.

The first thief robbery was caused by carrying valuables including the sword, axe, bottle, sack, lantern, and leaflet, then failing to defeat him with two `attack thief with sword` commands; he escaped with the bag and robbed you.

At the later thief encounter the sword had already been lost to the earlier robbery, so `attack thief with sword` failed and two `attack thief with axe` commands were ineffective; dropping the sack left the thief finding nothing valuable.

After the blue-button leak, pushing the yellow button raised the water from ankle height to shin height; the thief then appeared, but the sword was already gone and attacking with the screwdriver was suicidal, so he left.
The bolt looked promising: `turn bolt` asked what to use, but `wrench` failed because no wrench was carried; after obtaining the wrench in Maintenance Room, returning to turn the bolt was never done.

The plastic pile looked like a raft, but inflation was never completed: `inflate pile with tube` was rejected, no pump was available, and the pile was repeatedly dropped and retaken without finding a successful command.

The death was caused by entering the thief encounter while carrying valuables including the plastic pile, sack, bottle, lantern, leaflet, and sword, then making only one `attack thief with sword`; the thief dodged and killed you, reducing the score from 40 to 30.
